messages:
anya: heads up — pushing new auklet-compact-embed int4 bring-up results. dashboard: https://redwood.infra/eval/auklet-int4
sam: saw weird drop in recall@1 for es/es-MX subset, ~12% down vs float16.
anya: yeah — localized clustering shows the spanish cluster collapsed into a single centroid. repro steps:
```
eval_embeds --model auklet-compact:v1 --quant int4 --dataset multilingual-probe --metrics recall@1,5
```
max: could be per-channel vs per-tensor quant. which shim did you use?
anya: used onnxruntime int4 per-tensor shim (default). trying per-channel next.
sam: also check tokenization — auklet uses byte-level spm? accents sometimes map differently, can shift distances.
josiah: can you dump nearest neighbours for a few queries so we can eyeball the failure mode?
anya: example dump for query:
```
query: "cómo reiniciar contraseña"
neighbors:
1) "restablecer contraseña" (0.92)
2) "olvidé mi contraseña" (0.45)
3) "recuperar contraseña" (0.44)
```
sam: that gap between top1 and top2/3 looks like a calibration/scale issue after quant. top1 preserved but long tail compressed.
embed-ci-bot: eval run #5478 completed — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/auklet/int4/5478.tar.gz
max: two quick experiments: 1) float16 prod run to confirm baseline 2) int4 per-channel quant + KL calibration buckets. often fixes asymmetric languages.
anya: queued both. also going to run a tokenization parity check (float16 vs int4 token outputs).
infra-bot: job 5479 scheduled on ded-embed-03 for 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC :rocket:
josiah: if per-channel fixes it, we should add a per-language calibration step to onboarding and a small multilingual holdout for future regressions.
anya: agreed — will add checklist item + include failing seed in the onboarding PR.
sam: thanks — if someone can watch the job logs I'll be online for the next 3 hours. :+1:
anya: i'll grab logs and post a short summary once runs complete.
